Question 1
?

Find the general solution to the following equation. dydx+x2y=x2y2

Hint: You may wish to make use of the substitution z=y−1.

a
y=11+Cex3/3
b
y=(1+Cex3/3)2
c
y=11+Cex3
d
y=(2+Cx)2
e
y=ex2+C
Submit
